name: TradeSim
summary: A full-stack trading simulation platform that allows users to simulate stock trading, track portfolios and analyse market data through an interactive dashboard.
descriptions: Built a full-stack trading simulation platform with a React and Chart.js dashboard, implementing time-series portfolio tracking with memoised computations and dynamic filtering to support efficient rendering of large datasets.

name: Image Classifier
summary: A custom convolutional neural network built with Python and PyTorch to classify images from the CIFAR-10 dataset, achieving 92.8% training accuracy and 88.5% test accuracy.
descriptions: Designed and implemented a modular convolutional neural network using parallel convolutional paths with learned feature weighting, batch normalisation, dropout and adaptive pooling, achieving 92.8% training accuracy and 88.5% test accuracy.
Implemented data augmentation using random flips, colour jitter, rotation and cropping, alongside AdamW optimisation and learning-rate scheduling to improve model generalisation.

name: Tenzies Game
summary: A responsive Tenzies dice game built with React and JavaScript, featuring dice selection, hold mechanics, win detection, keyboard accessibility and animated victory feedback.
descriptions: Built an interactive dice game where players can selectively hold dice between rolls, with game-state logic determining valid holds and detecting when all dice match.
Implemented keyboard accessibility using tab navigation and Enter interactions, responsive styling for different screen sizes, and visual feedback for held dice and completed games.
Added a confetti animation and replay functionality when the player wins, providing immediate visual feedback and allowing the game to be restarted without refreshing the page.
